user.title: Set up Kraftvakt
user.description: Kraftvakt keeps the average consumption over the last hour just below your chosen power limit by switching power-hungry appliances on and off in priority order. After setup, configure the power limit and the appliances in the Kraftvakt panel in the sidebar.

regulation_not_started.title: The Kraftvakt regulation is not running
regulation_not_started.description: The regulation could not start because the configuration is not complete. Open Kraftvakt in the sidebar, complete the configuration and start the regulation.

missing_entity.title: An entity used by Kraftvakt no longer exists
missing_entity.description: {entity_id}, used by an appliance or an EV charger in Kraftvakt, no longer exists in Home Assistant. Choose another entity in the Kraftvakt panel, or remove the appliance or EV charger.

config_incomplete.message: The regulation cannot start before the configuration is complete. {count} settings are missing; see Kraftvakt in the sidebar.

unreadable_configuration.message: The stored configuration in .storage/kraftvakt.config cannot be read ({issues}). Kraftvakt is not started, and the file is left unchanged.
